title: Lyon stumble at Lens; Dortmund drop points in draw against Bremen
description:
Lens ended Lyon's unbeaten start to Ligue 1 while Borussia Dortmund dropped Bundesliga points for the first time this season after Werder Bremen rescue a late dramatic 2-2 draw on Friday.
In Spain, Malaga was still without a win after drawing with visiting Espanyol 1-1.
Hein shows great bottle for Bremen
=======================
Dortmund came into Friday's home match on top of the Bundesliga and the only club to win all four of its games so far.
While losing Amos Pieper to injury in the first half, Dortmund struggled to find a way past Karl Hein, who was outstanding in the Bremen goal. But even he could not hold stop Dortmund forever and the home side eventually seized control with goals in the 80th and 85th minutes from Daniel Svensson and Nico Schlotterbeck.
However, Bremen scored twice in the dying minutes to rescue an unlikely point.
